title: Savory Ukrainian-Style Couscous Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful bowl filled with grilled meats, toasted couscous, and a hint of malty sweetness.

ingredients.name: quick lamb
ingredients.notes: lamb shanks or lamb chops work well

instructions: Season lamb with salt, pepper, and a pinch of paprika.
Grill lamb for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Cook couscous according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat a tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in malted honey and cook for 1-2 minutes.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of cooked couscous in the bottom.
Add sliced grilled lamb on top of the couscous.
Drizzle with ukrainian sour cream and sprinkle with chopped fresh dill.
